about: Gold-labelled extraction cases for comparing local models with scripts/llm_eval.py. Case fixture-izmir is the request whose reply tests/test_llm/fixtures/vllm_chat_reply_schema.json captured from Flash-Next on 2026-10-03, and smoke-izmir is the request of scripts/llm_smoke.py; the tests pin both to their sources. The other texts are synthetic, written for this set: their numbers are not facts about the world, and each gold value is what its text states. A gold value {"$any": [...]} accepts any of the listed values. Strings compare without case, accents or extra spaces; numbers within 1e-9; arrays in any order.
system: You extract structured data from the text you are given. Use null for anything the text does not state. Write dates as YYYY-MM-DD, months as YYYY-MM and quarters as YYYY-Qn. Write numbers as plain JSON numbers: no units, no percent signs, no thousands separators. Answer with a JSON object only.

messages.content: In 2024 the city council of Izmir voted on the tram line.
You extract structured data from text.

Extract the city, the year, and whether the motion passed. Answer with a JSON object only.

In 2024 the city council of Izmir voted on extending the tram line to the university campus; the motion passed with 31 votes in favour.
